slice-wallet-judged-on-the-measured-outl.text: Slice: wallet judged on the measured outlay.

Opening a write session applies no floor. One pure judgement of a wallet against a required amount. Insert and terminate refuse a wallet under the fold reserve before building and under the measured outlay before signing. Insert, terminate and update refuse an empty wallet before building. The story's wallet previews and writes. The underfunded refusal names the wallet, equal in preview and write. The documentation states the rule. The narrowed gate passes on the final head.
